Donna di 29 anni. Mammografia bilaterale: 29-year-old woman. Bilateral mammography in two views (CC and MLO). Clinical question not available.
Referta in ordine: composizione, reperti: Report in order: composition, findings, conclusion with BI-RADS category.
Nelle donne giovani l'esame di prima sce:
In young women the first-choice exam for a palpable lump is ultrasound, but mammography remains useful for calcifications and extent. In this case mammography shows a large high-density mass with only partly circumscribed margins and, in the axilla, a round, large lymph node without fatty hilum: the whole is highly suspicious (BI-RADS 5, at least 4C).
Pitfall: triple-negative carcinoma grows quickly and often presents as a round or oval mass, with partly circumscribed margins, without spicules and without calcifications: it can look like a fibroadenoma, especially in a young woman. Size, high density, margins that are not entirely circumscribed and a pathologic lymph node point toward malignancy.
Management: ultrasound of the breast and axilla, percutaneous biopsy of the mass and needle biopsy of the lymph node, then staging and breast MRI (often before neoadjuvant chemotherapy). In a 29-year-old woman with triple-negative carcinoma, genetic counseling (BRCA) is also proposed.
Outcome from the collection: left triple-negative breast carcinoma; the status of the lymph node is not indicated.
